run_process_wiki_extractor_output: run the script to parse a WikiExtractor output file and extract document intro paragraphs into a pickle file
parse_wiki_extractor_docs: parse WikiExtractor XML output to extract document id, title, url, and first paragraph lines
extract_intro_paragraphs: extract the first paragraph lines from each WikiExtractor document and store them in a dictionary
dump_parsed_wiki_docs: dump parsed WikiExtractor documents as a pickle file mapping id-title tuples to url and intro lines
review_process_wiki_extractor_output: review the script that processes WikiExtractor output files and extracts document metadata and intro paragraphs
